body:
## Problem
askmilo.pro currently uses a generic dark/blue "AI SaaS" template look: glassmorphism cards, Inter/Space Grotesk type, a 9-link nav, and copy that repeats "one-time purchase / no subscription" ~9 times. It reads as a template rather than a premium, focused product page.

## Proposal
Move to a warm off-white, serif-display editorial design with a single accent colour, a trimmed information architecture, and deduplicated copy.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] New design tokens in `src/index.css`: paper `#FAFAF7` background, near-black ink text, single accent `#1D4ED8` for CTAs/links/active states; brand blue only in the logo mark and one hero glow.
- [ ] Instrument Serif headlines + Hanken Grotesk body; no remaining references to Inter or Space Grotesk.
- [ ] Glassmorphism replaced by hairline white cards; zero references to old tokens/classes (`milo-*`, `glass`, `slate-*`, `white/*`).
- [ ] Nav trimmed to 4 links; footer has its own link map.
- [ ] `HelpSection` becomes `HowItWorksSection` (3 numbered steps + interactive demo, state machine unchanged) placed under the problem statement; `CompareSection` becomes `ModelsSection`.
- [ ] "One-time purchase / no subscription" appears at most once per surface; pricing card shows the price once with 4 features, one CTA and one fine-print line; social-proof stat strip removed.
- [ ] FAQ uses a native `<details>` accordion and the FAQPage JSON-LD in `index.html` matches the trimmed answers.
- [ ] CTA label is "Download on the App Store" everywhere; floating CTA is mobile-only.
- [ ] Motion: no `transition: all` or hover-scale; hover effects gated behind `(hover:hover)`; `prefers-reduced-motion` respected.
- [ ] `theme-color` and `site.webmanifest` colours match the new background.
- [ ] No horizontal overflow at 390 / 768 / 1440 px; all text meets 4.5:1 contrast; skip link, carousel keyboard nav + aria, and analytics `trackEvent` calls preserved.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes clean.

## Out of scope
- `public/*.html` (changelog, privacy, terms, thanks) still on the old dark theme — follow-up.
- `<title>` / OG copy unchanged for SEO continuity.

## Metadata
- Type: feature
- Effort: L
title: Redesign landing page: light editorial theme, trimmed IA, deduplicated copy
